title: echinocereus coccineus subsp. rosei
intro: Echinocereus coccineus subsp. rosei, commonly known as the Rose Hedgehog, is a cactus species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The Rose Hedgehog has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including wounds, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Echinocereus coccineus subsp. rosei include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
